chapter: Instruments, tenors and the current band
title: Recent tenors: Joe Lovano and Gary Keller
summary: He singles out Joe Lovano as a bebop throwback and mentions Gary Keller; several of the group come from Long Island.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Now, are there some other tenor players who through all these years that you might pick out?
Yeah, I've had some very good guys. As a matter of fact, in recent times I've had some that shook me around and shook me up pretty good. I think that Joe Lavano --

-- was one of the most exciting tenor players who's a throwback to bebop between this age and the time, and I think he has created a whole different kind of way to express himself. And he's an individual player. And I also -- only recently had a guy come in and only do a couple, three, four weeks with me, a young man by the name of Gary Keller.
And he's from around New York and (inaudible). But he's part of this group. There's a whole group in this band from Long Island.
